# HintShell
> Personal Command Intelligence Engine & Local Real-time Terminal Autocomplete

HintShell is a lightweight, local command-suggestion engine written in Rust that embeds directly into shells (PowerShell, Bash, Git Bash, Zsh, WSL2). It delivers millisecond-latency command autocomplete, contextual filesystem navigation (`cd`), project stack awareness (`npm`, `pnpm`, `bun`, `cargo`, `docker`), and typo tolerance without transmitting any command history to external servers.

## Core Capabilities
- **Real-Time Interactive Overlay**: Displays a floating, scrollable suggestion box beneath the terminal prompt on interactive shells.
- **Smart Directory Navigation (`cd`)**: Dynamically resolves local directories sorted by modification time (`mtime`) with `cd ..` and `cd -` fast shortcuts.
- **Deep Context Engine**: Detects workspace indicator files (`Cargo.toml`, `package.json`, lockfiles, `docker-compose.yml`, `.git/index`) to suggest context-relevant build, test, dev, and git commands.
- **Typo Tolerance & Substring Matching**: Tolerates single-character typos (`gti` -> `git`) and provides fallback substring (`contains`) searches.
- **Client-Daemon Architecture**: High-speed IPC over Local Named Pipes (Windows) / Unix Domain Sockets (macOS/Linux) connecting CLI frontends to a local SQLite database engine.
- **Customizable UI (`~/.hintshell/config.toml`)**: Customizable border colors (`purple`, `rainbow`/`gemini`, `blue`, `cyan`, `green`, `yellow`, `pink`, `minimal`), result limits, and inline ghost text.

## Quick Reference
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/philau2512/hintshell
- **NPM Package**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/hintshell
- **Documentation & Usage**: See README.md in the repository root.

## Installation & CLI Commands
- Install: `npm install -g hintshell@latest --foreground-scripts`
- Setup: `hs init` (or `hs init --git-bash-fast` on Windows VS Code)
- Start Daemon: `hs start`
- Stop Daemon: `hs stop`
- Check Status: `hs status`
- Query Suggestions: `hintshell suggest "<input>" [--cwd "<path>"]`
- Update: `hs update`
- Uninstall: `hs uninstall`

## Tech Stack
- **Language**: Rust (Edition 2021)
- **Database**: Embedded SQLite with WAL mode (`rusqlite`)
- **Matching Engine**: Skim-based fuzzy matcher + Levenshtein distance
- **IPC Protocol**: JSON over Named Pipes / UDS
